articles.title: Global Climate Summit Reaches Historic Agreement
articles.description: World leaders gathered in Geneva have signed a landmark climate agreement aimed at reducing carbon emissions by 50% before 2035.
key_points: Funding of $500 billion pledged for green energy transition.
Annual progress reviews will be mandatory for all signatories.
impact: Significant reduction in global carbon emissions expected.
Thousands of green energy jobs to be created worldwide.
Improved air quality in major cities globally.

articles.title: Breakthrough in Artificial Intelligence Research
articles.description: Scientists have developed a new AI model capable of diagnosing diseases with 99% accuracy, potentially transforming the healthcare industry.
key_points: The model was trained on over 10 million medical records.
It can diagnose over 50 different conditions.
Clinical trials begin next year across 20 hospitals.
impact: Faster and more accurate disease diagnosis.
Improved patient outcomes and survival rates.

articles.title: Stock Markets Hit Record Highs
articles.description: Global stock markets surged to record highs this week driven by strong corporate earnings and positive economic data from major economies.
key_points: The S&P 500 crossed 6000 points for the first time.
Tech stocks led the rally with gains of over 5%.
Investor confidence at its highest level in a decade.
impact: Growth in retirement and investment portfolios.
Boost to overall economic confidence globally.
